newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Glorious Sun says IPO 236 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK's Glorious Sun says IPO 236 times subscribed.

text.p: Initial public offering of shares of casual wear maker and retailer Glorious Sun Enterprises Ltd was 236 times subscribed, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
Dealing in the company shares will begin on September 17, it said. HSBC Investment bank Asia Ltd is the global coordinater.

Glorious Sun has offered a total 250 million new shares, comprising a retail offer of 100 million and a placement of 150 million, in both cases at HK$1.60 per share. It said it would reallocate 25 million shares from placing to retail offering if that portion was over three times subscribed.
The company said it would use proceeds to develop and expand its Jeanswest retail network in China, Australia and New Zealand.
